conclusion.protocol_limit: On collab the gate trains on80% of official validation and selects on20%, requiring explicit supervision matching. Full expert fit/inference remains costly.
conclusion.relationship: Direct structure-conditioned expert-combination prior; M4 homogeneous parameter sharing is a practical architecture substitution, not a new routing or graph-learning principle.
conclusion.saved_takeaway: Link-MoE uses pair-specific softmax expert weights from separate MLP branches over structural heuristics and endpoint Hadamard features, then sigmoid of the weighted expert-score sum. Experts train independently and their inferred scores train a second-stage gate. Uniform/global ensembles and LP stacking are explicit controls.
conclusion.verified_title: Mixture of Link Predictors on Graphs

conclusion.adoption: Use as an attributed structural/diagnostic prior and possible later capable control. Do not claim new attention or factor-stratification principle.
conclusion.closest_prior_role: Pair-conditioned structural learner and factor-wise diagnostic
primary_text_verified: GCN node features plus target-pair context attention and learned PPR relative encoding.
CN, one-hop and more distant positional encoders; PPR thresholds limit context; counts enter final scalar decoder.
Factor partition already uses CN, PPR and cosine-feature heuristics; collab uses 80% in Appendix E.4.
Many baselines are borrowed from published tables; epoch timing and HeaRT are narrower comparisons than complete official collab cost/performance.
conclusion.title: LPFormer: An Adaptive Graph Transformer for Link Prediction

conclusion.operational_overlap: Graph ensemble fusion location before versus after decoding is already a design choice.
qualification_limits: Adaptive weight dimensions/optimization not source-code certified

Cora/Citeseer/PubMed claims do not qualify official collab or full cost
conclusion.remaining_delta: No query-dependent native NCNC probability bank, factorized private completion/decoder association or post-clamp twin identified in scoped source.
conclusion.saved_takeaway: Three autoencoder embedding matrices adaptively combined before common adjacency decoder; nested GCN/GAT/SuperGAT feature fusion. Explicit pre-decoder pooling precedent.
